WITH patient_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    l.ID,
    AVG(l.PT) as avg_PT,
    AVG(CASE WHEN l.ALP IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT != 0 
             THEN CAST(l.ALP AS REAL) / l.GPT 
             ELSE NULL END) as avg_ALP_GPT_ratio
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE l.ID NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-'
  )
  GROUP BY l.ID
),
patient_with_sex AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.SEX, '') as sex,
    ps.avg_PT,
    ps.avg_ALP_GPT_ratio
  FROM patient_stats ps
  INNER JOIN Patient p ON ps.ID = p.ID
)
SELECT 
  sex,
  AVG(avg_PT) as avg_PT_across_patients,
  AVG(avg_ALP_GPT_ratio) as avg_ratio_across_patients
FROM patient_with_sex
GROUP BY sex
ORDER BY sex
